worker_information: Exact frozen first-round system/user messages: full original question and supplied context plus that role; no self/peer/prior-sample message or sample marker
node_alias: r{sample}:w{role}; r means independent sample here, not conversational round
seed_policy: Unchanged derive_seed(question_id, execution_seed, node), including aggregate
aggregator_information: Full question/context and all 12 normalized wire slots in fixed role-major/sample-minor order; includes role/sample/node metadata and format-failure slots
sender_normalization: Frozen normalize_message with selected sender tokenizer and its output cap
receiver_accounting: Aggregator tokenizer encodes each of 12 wire strings; full templated input count remains backend-owned
configuration_notes: rounds=3 is required as the frozen three-sample alias; exact frozen four role prompts and fixed route required; other explicit GraphConfig changes alter protocol identity
cache: DISABLED; execute accepts no mask/base argument
backend_failure: Abort, no retry; retain all 13 planned slots with completed/failed/not-attempted states and partial_result on exception; no aggregate after worker exception
format_failure: Keep paid Generation and frozen FORMAT_ERROR wire in its original slot; continue and aggregate all 12 slots
postgeneration_failure: Retain returned Generation and costs, abort without silent replacement
failure_costs: Within one attempted backend request, same identified call states are charged once only for metrics whose reports are all complete, valid and equal. Missing/conflicting metrics are null, with event evidence and known subtotal retained. No latest/max imputation.
occupancy_ledger: Not supplied by this adapter; caller must retain a separate supervised resident-GPU ledger before any real execution
real_model_engineering_qualification: NOT_RUN; original graph qualification does not qualify this new control

required: seed matching request in every report
cost_identity.missing_call_id: Keep reports separate and mark identity uncertain; neither merge nor assume additive physical calls
cost_identity.multiple_ids_in_request: Identity uncertain; do not infer hidden retries from event rows

cost_ranges: Observed per-field min/max describe reports only, not truth bounds. Known subtotal excludes ambiguous groups; total upper is null whenever unresolved. Peak max only combines reconciled distinct request costs.
event_status_semantics: SUCCESS/FAILED are states, not proof of repeat generation
repair_review_scope: Original defect was independently reviewed. v2 repair tests are performed by the repairer and are not labelled a second independent approval.
